rights.note: The book (translated by Ali Quli Qara'i, Foundation of Islamic Cultural Propagation in the World, 1997) is in copyright. This pilot covers Chapter 5, The Stormy Sea of Life, in original wording written from the al-Islam.org text supplied by the owner: it follows the chapter's argument, quotes none of the translation, and gives the Qur'an and the sayings it cites as references with our own rendering of their meaning. No drawings of people. Author and translator checked on al-Islam.org on 24 Nov 2026. Not reviewed by a lawyer or a scholar.

ideas.name: Why the storm feels worse now
ideas.can: Explain the chapter's claim that comfort has not brought peace, name the causes of anxiety it identifies, and say how it treats mistakes and the unknown future.

ideas.name: What hardship is for
ideas.can: Say why escape does not solve pain, and explain how the chapter argues that hardship refines a person.

ideas.name: Anchors in the storm
ideas.can: Name the chapter's anchors in hardship and tell rida (contentment with God's decree) apart from accepting injustice.
